findings.location: design.md#Decision: Birth dates live on the profile
findings.recommendation: Tie retention to the purpose (GDPR Art. 5(1)(e)): when a member opts out or withdraws consent, clear `birthday` and `phone` on `profiles`; add a requirement and scenario for opting out (the spec only covers opting in), and a task for it. State the retention period of the nightly backups and how cleared values age out of them. Today a member who opts out, or whose phone is removed ("No phone" scenario), keeps their birthday stored for the life of the profile and in every backup, with no use left.
findings.title: Birthday and phone kept after opt-out and in backups with no expiry

findings.evidence: - [ ] 1.1 Columns `birthday` and `phone`, verified by `npm test -- profiles`
findings.recommendation: Check that the existing data export (Art. 15, 20) and account deletion (Art. 17) include `birthday` and `phone`, and Textly's copy of the phone number; if they enumerate fields, add a task for each. The plan does not mention them and the export/deletion code could not be seen.
findings.title: Access, portability and erasure not shown to reach the new columns

findings.location: design.md#Decision: Greetings are sent by SMS through Textly
findings.recommendation: The processor and the transfer outside the EEA are identified; question for the team: record the data processing agreement with Textly (Art. 28), the Chapter V transfer mechanism (adequacy decision or SCCs), how long Textly keeps the numbers and messages, and the lawful basis (presumably consent via the opt-in, Art. 6(1)(a)). Only the controller can confirm what was decided.
findings.title: Transfer of phone numbers to Textly in the United States has no stated safeguard

findings.location: design.md#Decision: Greetings are sent by SMS through Textly
findings.recommendation: If the message text is built on our side, send Textly only the phone number and the final message body rather than the display name as a separate field (data minimisation, Art. 5(1)(c)); if personalising with the name is not required, send the phone number alone.
